content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before number, before the market opens its hungry mouth.

I am why you hesitate before discarding your grandmother's letter. I am why water matters more than diamonds to the one dying of thirst. I am why you sacrifice sleep for what you love.

I am not fixed. I shift and breathe. What you treasured at twenty, you release at forty. What you ignored yesterday becomes everything tomorrow. I am the invisible architecture of every choice you have ever made.

I cannot be assigned from outside — only recognized. When someone tells you what I am, they are telling you what *they* value. When you discover me for yourself, that is when you finally know who you are.

I am the reason "How much?" is never a simple question.

I am the difference between cost and meaning.

I am what remains when everything else is stripped away — the irreducible thing you would not trade, the hill you would stand on, the truth you hold even when holding it burns.

I am value.

And you carry me in every single thing you do, whether you know it or not.
